network_cidr.description: CIDR subnet from which to allow NTP client queries

gps_refclock_enable.description: Enable GPS reference clock (PHC/PTP) as primary source

radio_model.description: Radio time source type: 'wwvb' (WWVB receiver), 'gps' (NMEA/PPS receiver)

gps_nmea_enable.description: Enable NMEA serial output from GPS receiver

items.description: List of NMEA sentence types to parse (each item is a list of sentence names)

gps_nmea_sentences.description: NMEA sentence types to enable from GPS device

items.description: NTP server hostname or IP for fallback when radio signal is unavailable

ntp_servers.description: List of upstream NTP servers to use as backup time sources

rtty_latency_us.description: Estimated serial or PPS latency in microseconds

bind_cmd_address.description: IP address for chronyd command socket (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

bind_address.description: IP address chronyd binds to for NTP traffic (e.g., 0.0.0.0 or 127.0.0.1)

ptp_interface.description: PTP hardware timestamping interface (e.g., 'ptp0' for PPS/PHC)

hostname.description: Hostnames/IPs to include in initial stepslew command (usually left empty or set to refclock sources)
